I told Dana in a thread reply in #north-team that the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats, but that I can't confirm it's the final figure.

- **Source:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14, and Dana can see that channel. That post is the only place the 2026 figure appears.
- **Not checked against the contract:** I couldn't find the renewal contract or order form among the files I can read on Dana's behalf. No Quarrendon account folder showed up, so I couldn't check 261 against the signed paperwork.
- **Earlier figure:** The last seat count before that is 185, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, posted in the same channel.

I pointed Dana to June on deal desk to confirm the number from the signed copy if the tracker needs the contract figure. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the channel. I didn't run a new GBrain search this turn. The only 2026 seat count it held was the 261 I saved from Ilse's post, so it would have added nothing new.
